channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Marzetti Launches Simply Dressed Line
item.description: Marzetti debuts Simply Dressed, a refreshed lineup replacing its Simply dressings line. The new offerings emphasize clean ingredients and flavor-forward formulations.

item.title: Prepared Seafood Swims Into Spotlight
item.description: From chili lime shrimp and salmon burgers to ghost pepper tuna packets and smoked salmon candy, processors are casting wider nets for adventurous shoppers. With protein, omega-3s and Gen Z appeal in focus, seafood is staking a bigger claim across the retail store.

item.title: Javvy Coffee Launches Clear Protein Refreshers
item.description: Javvy Coffee is expanding its protein lineup with Clear Protein Refreshers, combining protein, caffeine and electrolytes in a lighter format. The new offering delivers functional benefits without artificial ingredients or added sugar

item.title: General Mills Unveils Spring Product Lineup
item.description: General Mills is rolling out a mix of new products and returning favorites for spring, spanning baking mixes, cookies and snacks. The lineup blends indulgent flavors with better-for-you options designed for seasonal moments

item.title: Danone to Acquire Complete Nutrition Brand Huel
item.description: Danone is acquiring Huel to strengthen its position in functional nutrition and tap into rising demand for complete meal solutions. The deal pairs Huel’s digital-first model with Danone’s global scale to drive growth and innovation

item.title: NuSpice Launches Retro-Inspired ‘NuStalgia’ Campaign
item.description: NuSpice is blending nostalgia with flavor innovation through a campaign centered on chili crunch seasoning concepts and interactive brand experiences. The initiative showcases how global flavor trends can translate into versatile, ready-to-use product solutions.

item.title: Fly By Jing Expands Premium Noodle Line
item.description: Fly By Jing is adding Creamy Sesame and Roasted Garlic to its instant noodle lineup, featuring triple-fermented, knife-cut noodles with 12g of protein per serving. The launch reflects premiumization trends and growing demand for globally inspired flavors with varied heat levels.

item.title: Frozen Finds New Growth Drivers
item.description: High-protein meals, $14.3B in takeout-style offerings and value-size formats are redefining how consumers use the freezer. From multigenerational dinners to Gen Z breakfast bowls at any hour, frozen is evolving beyond convenience into a daily solution.

item.title: Joseph’s Bakery Invests In Tumaro’s Growth
item.description: Joseph’s Bakery is advancing Tumaro’s following its acquisition, building on the wrap brand’s better-for-you positioning and flavor-forward lineup. The company plans increased support and innovation to drive expansion across retail and e-commerce

item.title: natural bliss Launches Creamer Campaign
item.description: natural bliss is rolling out a new creative platform alongside fresh flavors and redesigned packaging for its dairy creamers. A partnership with Meghann Fahy brings the launch to life through a high tea-inspired coffee experience

item.title: Innovating School Meals Under New Nutrition Rules
item.description: New USDA limits on sugar and sodium, alongside a push for more protein, are reshaping school meal product development. Manufacturers that treat these shifts as innovation opportunities can deliver nutritious, appealing foods that drive participation.

item.title: Health, Digital Trends Reshape Beverage Demand
item.description: Consumers are prioritizing health benefits, ingredients and lower sugar, with many willing to pay more for functional beverages. Digital tools and younger generations are accelerating changes in how drinks are discovered, purchased and consumed.

item.title: Kroger Forecasts 2026 Flavor Shifts
item.description: From cottage cheese comebacks and dill pickle protein crackers to yuzu seltzers and tikka masala sauces, Kroger sees bold, functional flavor leading the cart. In 2026, shoppers will seek premium experiences at value prices across snacks, meals and beverages.

item.title: Rise Baking Expands Utah Production Facility
item.description: Rise Baking Company is expanding its Utah facility to boost capacity and streamline operations, including increased pie production. The move will add jobs while consolidating manufacturing, including the closure of its Washington plant.

item.title: Perfect Snacks Launches Protein + Prebiotics Bar
item.description: Perfect Snacks is introducing Protein + Prebiotics, a refrigerated bar delivering 20g of protein and prebiotic fiber without artificial ingredients. The launch reflects demand for high-protein snacks that also support gut health and clean-label expectations.
